BillHeading.BriefDescription: Requiring students to study political systems and the negative effects of communism.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring students to study political systems and the negative effects of communism; and amending RCW 28A.230.170.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 28A.230.170 and 2011 c 203 s 3 are each amended to read as follows:Study of constitutions compulsory—Rules.
BillSection.P: (1)(a) The study of (i) the Constitution of the United States and (ii) the Constitution of the state of Washington shall be a condition prerequisite to graduation from the public and private high schools of this state.

P.TextRun: (b) The study of the history and negative effects of communism, including the number of deaths under communist leaders, shall be a condition prerequisite to graduation from the public high schools of this state.

BillSection.P: (2) The superintendent of public instruction shall provide by rule for the implementation of this section.

(3)(a) The superintendent of public instruction may adopt a rule permitting students who meet the criteria in RCW 28A.230.122 to meet the prerequisite in subsection (1)(a) of this section through noncredit-based study.

P.TextRun: (b) The superintendent of public instruction shall adopt a rule permitting students who take the heritage guide to the Constitution to meet the prerequisite in subsection (1)(a)(i) of this section through noncredit-based study.
